purpose: A template for noting the quantities a rule leaves open and the decisions changed after the values were seen, with the image each one acted on, filled in for work 1 as the worked example. It is the table readers copy for their own series.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-10-28 and committed before any script for it exists and before anything is drawn. Seen before: everything of results/work1 and results/work1_drawing and the record of the decisions in the working notes. Version 2 (2026-10-28, still before any script or drawing), after the cross review of the task: every image a quantity acted on is listed (no 'all'; common_eps.png added where it applies); each value is a path to a key or a literal checked against one.

columns.header: Before or after the values were seen (if after: what was seen)

rows_work1.when: before: counts without a lexicon only

value.format: common to the series, D = {D_mm} mm (per-tile min-max shown next to it)

value.literal: grey; light from the upper left and from the lower right at 45 degrees; stretched per tile

rows_work1.when: after: every image and value of work 1 (the way of drawing and the twelve tiles were committed before drawing)

value.literal: as a whole set of tiles

rows_work1.when: after: the check of the flow of the story

acted_on_labels: in the repository the column holds the image files; the numbers of the figures of the paper are put in when the manuscript is made, outside the repository

layout.empty_template: the same table with the four headers and three empty rows is drawn next to it

outputs: results/decision_note/decision_note.png, decision_note.md (the same table as text) and decision_note.json (the values read and the SHA-256 of the conditions)
not_claimed: A way of noting decisions; it does not show that noting them helps a reader (no study with people). Disclosure helps a reader repeat the work but does not by itself settle whether a reading is valid or a choice biased.
checks: every file named exists and is the one at HEAD; every key read exists; every must_contain string occurs in the keys named (else the run stops)
